ACK queue management and ACK frame generation for QUIC packets.

# Purpose
This file implements ACK generation for `fd_quic`. It manages a queue of pending ACK ranges, merges new packet numbers into the most recent range when possible, and drops ACKs that no longer match the active encryption level. The main entry point, [`fd_quic_ack_pkt`](<#fd_quic_ack_pkt>), records received packet numbers and either extends an existing ACK range or creates a new queued ACK entry. The helper functions [`fd_quic_range_can_extend`](<#fd_quic_range_can_extend>) and [`fd_quic_range_extend`](<#fd_quic_range_extend>) define the range merge rules used by the queue logic.

The file also builds ACK frames for transmission in [`fd_quic_gen_ack_frames`](<#fd_quic_gen_ack_frames>). That function sends queued ACK ranges only when `gen->is_elicited` is set, which prevents an ACK loop. For each queued range that matches the current encryption level, it computes the ACK delay, fills an `fd_quic_ack_frame_t`, and encodes it with [`fd_quic_encode_ack_frame`](<#fd_quic_encode_ack_frame>). The file therefore provides the transmit-side ACK state machine for QUIC, including queue management, range coalescing, frame encoding, and ACK suppression rules.
